casesynthetic_a16.description: Synthetic Android 16 style bug report text (dumpstate.txt) with two Android users, in the Europe/Paris zone: accounts with a history table and a visibility list, sync status tables (one with a failure cell), recent sync history, per adapter history, backup transports and queues, two user records, a battery history with a printed date on every record, daily periods with package changes, estimated power use, wake locks, thermalservice, power wake locks with the wake up and release histories, device idle, process stats, threads from ps and meminfo with the process lists and blocks. Invented values, contains no real evidence.

casesynthetic_a10.description: Synthetic Android 10 style bug report text (bugreport-*.txt, CRLF line endings) with one user, in the Europe/Paris zone: the same sections in the older shapes (sync entries printed as account/ uN (type uN [authority]), battery history with offsets from clock records and a wrapped details line, Uid power lines, no PowerHistorian lists, a user record without Type and Flags, meminfo blocks without Rss columns and without process lists). Invented values, contains no real evidence.

casesynthetic_two_reports.description: Two synthetic bug report texts in two folders (Android 16 style in Asia/Kolkata and Android 10 style in America/Sao_Paulo): both are read and the Source File column tells their rows apart. Invented values, contains no real evidence.

casesynthetic_cut.description: Synthetic Android 16 style bug report text whose meminfo service dump ends with the DUMP TIMEOUT marker and has no trailer: the rows read before the cut are listed and the cut is logged. Invented values, contains no real evidence.

casesynthetic_empty.description: Synthetic bug report text with the banner and no sections. Invented values, contains no real evidence.

casesynthetic_not_a_report.description: Two files that match the path patterns but carry no dumpstate banner (a text and a block of arbitrary bytes): neither is read and no rows are reported. Invented values, contains no real evidence.
